subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which public bind grammar should OpenClaw support for Feishu conversation routing before this PR can merge?
rationale: The patch changes a documented CLI input that writes persisted route bindings, and there are multiple open candidate PRs with different compatibility tradeoffs.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add safe peer handling
options.body: Keep existing channel/account behavior as the default, then add explicit peer syntax or plugin-owned Feishu conversation recognition with docs and tests.

options.title: Accept Feishu default peer reinterpretation
options.body: Approve feishu:<value> as a group-peer shortcut, but require upgrade guidance and proof that account-scoped setups remain expressible.

options.title: Choose a sibling candidate
options.body: Pause or close this branch in favor of another open candidate if it better matches the desired compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add safe peer handling
recommendation.body: Keep existing channel/account behavior as the default, then add explicit peer syntax or plugin-owned Feishu conversation recognition with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent docs/routing and Feishu conversation-id history makes this the best available routing candidate for the bind grammar decision.
